summary_1line: King Samvarana encounters the radiant maiden Tapati in the forest, falls passionately in love, and desperately begs her to accept him in Gandharva marriage.

image_candidates.scene_text: On a golden-lit mountain clearing, King Samvarana stands stunned before the radiant maiden Tapati, whose beauty makes the surrounding forest seem turned to gold.
The lovestruck king collapses on the forest floor in despair as the maiden vanishes like lightning among the trees.
Tapati reappears smiling over the fallen king, urging him to rise while he looks up at her with desperate longing.
